checks.claim: rh_market_states 每一列的非 NULL 行数与不同取值个数
checks.method: Python sqlite3 只读打开 reports/lp_rh/scanner.db，对每列执行 count(col) 与 count(distinct col)；distinct=1 时附常量值
checks.command:
/root/lp-bot/.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('file:reports/lp_rh/scanner.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
cur = con.cursor()
cols = [r[1] for r in cur.execute("pragma table_info(rh_market_states)")]
total = cur.execute("select count(*) from rh_market_states").fetchone()[0]
print("table=rh_market_states total_rows=", total)
for c in cols:
    nn, dc = cur.execute(f"select count({c}), count(distinct {c}) from rh_market_states").fetchone()
    extra = ""
    if dc == 1:
        v = cur.execute(f"select {c} from rh_market_states where {c} is not null limit 1").fetchone()[0]
        extra = f" const_value={v!r}"
    print(f"col={c} nonnull={nn} distinct={dc}{extra}")
con.close()
EOF
